description: Speaks a line of text with a local text-to-speech model and saves it as a wav. The result declares no 'sample_rate': a generated track carries the rate its model produced it at, so saying nothing is what saves it correctly. Bark's 'voice_preset' selects the speaker - give two characters two presets and they sound like two people.

variables.text: Somebody finished the pistachio and nobody is saying anything.
